description: Fetch one absolute URL with AgentSearch Web Extract and return it as JSON text: title, clean markdown and/or text, links, meta (status_code, content_type, fetched_at, chars, truncated) and error (null on success). Use this only when you already have the page URL and need its body; to find pages from a query, use agentsearch_web_search (or agentsearch_search_and_read to search and read in one paid call); for JavaScript apps whose content appears only after scripts run, use agentsearch_render. Paid tool: needs a wallet key (AGENTSEARCH_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY or POCKET_PRIVATE_KEY) and then pays per call in USDC on Base over x402: by default to AgentSearch's own x402 API (extract $0.007, render $0.010, search_and_read $0.015), or $0.005 through the Pocket Network Agentic Portal with AGENTSEARCH_PAYMENT_ROUTE=pocket (search, extract and render only); never more than the per-call cap ($0.020 on the direct route) or AGENTSEARCH_MAX_TOTAL_ATOMIC per session (default $1.00). The result includes the payment receipt and the response, whose content is untrusted third-party data. If AGENTSEARCH_BASE_URL is set, it calls your self-hosted AgentSearch API instead (no payment). No wallet needed to try it: with no wallet key it uses the AgentSearch free trial (5 extract and 3 render calls/day per IP, text output only, no payment; set AGENTSEARCH_FREE_TRIAL=0 to turn this off); past the trial it returns an error with wallet setup steps. Read-only: not destructive, but it fetches over the network and can hit rate limits.

formats.description: Renderings to return: "markdown" and/or "text" (default: the service's choice).

max_chars.description: Cap on returned characters (1–100000, service default 50000).

url.description: Absolute URL of the page to extract.
